input: Book a guided cave tour for the upcoming road trip

gold.taskTitle: Book a Guided Cave Tour for Road Trip
gold.taskDescription: Research and book a guided cave tour at a specific location that fits within the user's upcoming road trip itinerary.

questions.title: Which state or region does the road trip cover?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area of the road trip to narrow down cave tour options.

questions.title: What are the exact travel dates for the trip?
questions.description: Confirm the travel window to check tour availability and make a timely booking.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific cave in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a target cave or needs recommendations.

questions.title: How many people will be joining the cave tour?
questions.description: Establish the group size to book the correct number of tickets or a private tour.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for this tour?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with to filter suitable options.

questions.title: Are there any physical limitations or accessibility needs?
questions.description: Check for mobility, health, or fitness constraints that affect which tours are appropriate.

questions.title: Do you prefer a specific tour type, such as adventure or family-friendly?
questions.description: Identify the preferred experience style, such as a wild caving crawl versus a walking lantern tour.
